name: GitHub MCP Server
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C2, C3, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10; partly meets C1, C4, C5.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The source repository is public and release v2.1.0 is published from it. Its assets are platform archives and a checksums file (`github-mcp-server_2.1.0_checksums.txt`); no signature or attestation file is among the release assets, and the README does not describe verifying one (searched for: cosign, sigstore, attestation, provenance).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release v2.1.0 is dated 2026-11-03; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 2 advisories are published in the repository's advisory list. GHSA-w4q6-qw23-4rg7 (high, published 2026-07-20) names no patched version; its stated affected range is "<= 0.33.0 (also affects latest main)", which does not clearly include or exclude the latest release (v2.1.0). The other advisory names a patched version below the latest release.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README documents an opt-in read-only mode and toolset selection; without the flag, write tools in the enabled toolsets are offered. Quoted: “To run the server in read-only mode, you can use the `--read-only` flag. This will only offer read-only tools, preventing any modifications to repositories, issues, pull requests, etc.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Authentication is by OAuth sign-in or a personal access token supplied through an environment variable. Quoted: “use the `github-mcp-server stdio` command with the `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable set to your token”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`go.sum`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README names prompt injection from untrusted repository content and documents lockdown mode as a filter for it, stating its limits. Quoted: “Lockdown mode is a best-effort content filter intended to reduce the risk of prompt injection from untrusted repository content”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: go-sdk v1.8.0 in go.mod. Lower-bound version v1.8.0 of github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk was published on 2026-09-04, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
